title: CONTAINSROW needs the whole row to match, not each value somewhere

source.quote: Returns TRUE if there exists at least one row where all columns have specified values.
source.supports: all the columns of one row must match

derivation: (2024, 1) is the second row: TRUE. (2023, 1) takes 2023 from the first row and 1 from the second; no single row holds both: FALSE.
